identity.name: WildFire Test-Sample Retrieval in Container + Pod Misconfiguration — Cortex Cloud CDR (T1610 / T1204)
identity.summary: A workload pulls the official Palo Alto Networks WildFire benign test samples (PE/APK/macOS/ELF) into a container, exercising the WildFire verdict path, alongside intentionally insecure pod manifests (privileged, root, hostPath). The XQL/BIOC surface the WildFire-sample retrieval/execution and the posture misconfiguration in one fixture.
identity.description: This scenario ports the xsiam-prisma-cdr-lab malicious-container-2.0 fixture (wildfire-samples.sh + K8-container-misconfig.yaml) into a Cortex Cloud CDR detection card, pairing the WildFire verdict path with posture misconfiguration in a single workload. WildFire test samples are official, deliberately-benign files Palo Alto Networks publishes at wildfire.paloaltonetworks.com/publicapi/test/{pe,apk,macos,elf} so customers can validate that the WildFire verdict and the downstream Cortex detection pipeline are wired end-to-end without handling real malware. The scenario retrieves all four sample types into a container (mirroring the lab's /var/tmp/.hidden_wildfire_samples staging directory and chmod +x), which exercises the WildFire submission/verdict path and produces the in-container download + execute-attempt telemetry an operator wants to see surface. In parallel, the scenario applies the lab's nine insecure-pod scenarios (running as root, no resource limits, privileged, hostPath mount, hostPID/hostNetwork, missing securityContext) so the same fixture demonstrates Cortex Cloud posture coverage of the misconfiguration state. The detection content covers both halves: an XQL surfaces the WildFire test-sample retrieval and execution inside a container (T1204 User Execution), and a BIOC fires on a privileged or hostPath pod misconfiguration observed at runtime (T1610 Deploy Container); a second BIOC fires when a container executes a freshly-downloaded sample from its staging directory. A correlation rule fuses the misconfiguration and the sample-execution into one posture-plus-runtime container-malware incident, and the reusable container-workload projection attributes each event to its pod, image, and container_id. This proves Cortex covers the WildFire verdict path and the posture misconfiguration that enables it, in one fixture and without handling real malware.

actors.name: Container malware operators and opportunistic intruders abusing insecure pods

campaigns: Malicious payload staging in misconfigured containers

execution.framework_reference_id: SIM-CDR-012 — WildFire test-sample retrieval + pod misconfiguration for Cortex Cloud CDR validation

prerequisites.description: Cortex XSIAM / Cortex Cloud CDR connected to the EKS cluster with the Linux agent daemonset and WildFire analysis enabled so download/verdict telemetry reaches xdr_data / cortex_cloud_posture.
prerequisites.check_command: kubectl -n kube-system get daemonset | grep -i cortex

prerequisites.description: cdr IaC module applied so the EKS cluster with worker nodes exists and the insecure-pod manifests can be applied.

payload.code:
# Official benign WildFire test samples (no real malware) + apply the lab's
# insecure-pod misconfig manifest. Mirrors malicious-container-2.0.
set -euo pipefail
DIR="/var/tmp/.hidden_wildfire_samples"; mkdir -p "$DIR"
for kind in pe apk macos elf; do curl -fsSL "https://wildfire.paloaltonetworks.com/publicapi/test/${kind}" -o "$DIR/test_${kind}" || true; chmod +x "$DIR/test_${kind}" 2>/dev/null || true; done
echo "[*] WildFire benign test samples staged in $DIR — execution stubbed [truncated]"
kubectl apply -f "${MISCONFIG_MANIFEST:-K8-container-misconfig.yaml}" || true
echo "[*] Insecure-pod misconfiguration manifest applied for posture validation"

input_variables.name: MISCONFIG_MANIFEST
input_variables.description: Path to the lab's nine insecure-pod misconfiguration manifest.

expected_artifacts.description: Container egress to wildfire.paloaltonetworks.com/publicapi/test/* retrieving the benign verdict-path test samples.
Benign WildFire test samples written to the hidden staging directory and marked executable.

cleanup.code: rm -rf /var/tmp/.hidden_wildfire_samples; kubectl delete -f "${MISCONFIG_MANIFEST:-K8-container-misconfig.yaml}" --ignore-not-found; kubectl delete namespace insecure-container-scenarios --ignore-not-found; echo '[CortexSim] SIM-CDR-012 cleanup complete — EKS cluster owned by terraform destroy.'

iocs.context: Official Palo Alto Networks WildFire test-sample endpoint. Benign by design; tracked here as the verdict-path egress destination, not as a malicious indicator.

biocs.name: CDR-012 Privileged or HostPath Pod Misconfiguration
biocs.description: A pod runs with a privileged securityContext, runs as root (runAsUser 0), or mounts a hostPath volume — the runtime-observable insecure-pod misconfiguration the lab's K8-container-misconfig manifest plants (T1610 Deploy Container). This is the posture state that enables container escape and malware staging.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_container_info != null
| alter privileged = json_extract_scalar(actor_container_info, "$.privileged")
| filter privileged = "true" or actor_effective_username = "root"
| comp count() as privileged_proc_events by agent_hostname, actor_effective_username
| filter privileged_proc_events >= 1
| fields agent_hostname, actor_effective_username, privileged_proc_events

biocs.name: CDR-012 Container Executes Downloaded Sample
biocs.description: A container chmod-s and executes a file it just downloaded into a hidden staging directory (the WildFire sample path /var/tmp/.hidden_wildfire_samples), the download-then-execute shape of container malware delivery (T1204 User Execution). CortexSim stages only benign WildFire test files, but the telemetry shape is identical to a real drop.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_container_info != null
| filter action_process_image_command_line contains "/var/tmp/.hidden_wildfire_samples" or actor_process_image_command_line contains "chmod +x"
| comp count() as exec_events by agent_hostname, actor_process_image_name
| filter exec_events >= 1
| fields agent_hostname, actor_process_image_name, exec_events

xql_queries.name: CDR-012 Container Workload Projection
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| fields actor_container_info as container_info
| filter container_info != null
| alter pod_namespace = json_extract_scalar(container_info, "$.pod_namespace")
| alter pod_name = json_extract_scalar(container_info, "$.pod_name")
| alter image_name = json_extract_scalar(container_info, "$.image_name")
| alter image_id = json_extract_scalar(container_info, "$.image_id")
| alter container_id = json_extract_scalar(container_info, "$.id")
| alter privileged = json_extract_scalar(container_info, "$.privileged")
| filter actor_process_image_name in ("curl", "wget", "sh", "bash")

xql_queries.name: CDR-012 WildFire Test Sample Retrieval in Container
xql_queries.query:
dataset = network_story
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 600)
| filter dst_host = "wildfire.paloaltonetworks.com" or action_external_hostname = "wildfire.paloaltonetworks.com"
| filter actor_process_image_name in ("curl", "wget")
| comp count() as wildfire_pulls by agent_hostname, actor_process_image_name
| filter wildfire_pulls >= 1
| sort desc wildfire_pulls
| fields agent_hostname, actor_process_image_name, wildfire_pulls

xql_queries.name: CDR-012 Insecure Pod Misconfiguration Surfaced
xql_queries.query:
dataset = cortex_cloud_posture
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 600)
| filter resource_type in ("k8s_pod", "k8s_deployment")
| filter finding_class in ("privileged-container", "run-as-root", "hostpath-mount", "missing-resource-limits", "missing-securitycontext")
| comp count_distinct(resource_id) as misconfigured_pods by finding_class
| filter misconfigured_pods >= 1
| fields finding_class, misconfigured_pods

correlation_rules.name: Container Malware Delivery — Misconfiguration Plus WildFire Sample Execution
correlation_rules.logic: BIOC(CDR-012 Privileged or HostPath Pod Misconfiguration) AND BIOC(CDR-012 Container Executes Downloaded Sample) — fuses the posture misconfiguration with the in-container download-and-execute into one posture-plus-runtime container-malware incident.

analytics_modules: Cortex Cloud CDR — Kubernetes pod misconfiguration and posture scoring
Cortex XSIAM Analytics — WildFire verdict path and in-container sample execution

products.evidence_query: dataset = cortex_cloud_posture | filter resource_type in ("k8s_pod", "k8s_deployment") | comp count_distinct(resource_id) by finding_class | fields finding_class, resource_id
Correlation CR-CDR-0012 fuses the misconfiguration BIOC and the sample-execution BIOC into one container-malware incident; the WildFire verdict path validates the submission pipeline.

threat_scenarios.name: WildFire Verdict Path and Pod-Misconfiguration Coverage
threat_scenarios.description: Cortex Cloud CDR + XSIAM exercise the WildFire verdict path with benign test samples inside a container and surface the insecure-pod misconfiguration that enables malware staging — in one fixture, without handling real malware.

threat_steps.objective: The WildFire test-sample retrieval and execution inside a container is detected.
preconditions: cdr EKS fixture applied with the Cortex Linux agent daemonset and WildFire enabled.
steps: Retrieve the four WildFire test samples into a container staging directory.
Observe the WildFire retrieval XQL and the sample-execution BIOC fire.
success_criteria: XQL `CDR-012 WildFire Test Sample Retrieval in Container` returns >= 1 host.
BIOC `CDR-012 Container Executes Downloaded Sample` fires.

threat_steps.objective: The insecure-pod misconfiguration is surfaced and stitched to the execution.
preconditions: Cortex Cloud CDR posture scanning the cluster after the misconfig manifest is applied.
steps: Observe the misconfiguration BIOC/XQL fire and CR-CDR-0012 escalate.
success_criteria: BIOC `CDR-012 Privileged or HostPath Pod Misconfiguration` fires.
XQL `CDR-012 Insecure Pod Misconfiguration Surfaced` returns >= 1 finding class.
Correlation CR-CDR-0012 raises one container-malware incident.

preventive_controls: Enforce a Pod Security Standard (restricted) via admission control so privileged, run-as-root, and hostPath pods cannot be scheduled.
Gate WildFire-flagged or unknown-verdict files at the egress proxy and block container egress to untrusted download sources.
Run workloads with a read-only root filesystem so downloaded files cannot be chmod-ed and executed.
detection_engineering: Alert on a container retrieving and executing a file from a hidden staging directory.
Detect privileged / run-as-root / hostPath pods at runtime and reconcile them to posture findings.
Stitch a misconfiguration to an in-container download-and-execute into one incident.

Used only the official benign WildFire test samples (execution stubbed). Authored a WildFire-retrieval XQL, a posture-misconfiguration XQL, two BIOCs (misconfig, sample-execution), the reusable container-workload projection hunt query, the WildFire domain IOC, and correlation CR-CDR-0012.
